import os,stat,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
name='diag_authorized_hf_cleanup_plan_01'
src=Path('logs/review/diag_hf_ckpts_inventory_02/report.json');d=json.loads(src.read_text())
assert not d['reference_scan_errors']
root=Path('/scratch/e1583364/hf_ckpts');assert root.resolve()==root and root.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
rows=[];groups=[];kept=[]
for g in d['rows']:
 p=Path(g['path'])
 if g['status']!='eligible_candidate_after_root_review':kept.append({'path':str(p),'reason':g.get('protection_reasons',g['status'])});continue
 assert 'qwen2.5-vl-3b-instruct' not in p.name.lower() and not g['reference_evidence'] and not g['protection_reasons'] and not g['foreign_owned_entries'] and not g['symlinks_not_followed']
 assert p.parent==root and p.resolve()==p and p.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
 own=[]
 for parent,dirs,files in os.walk(p,followlinks=False):
  for basename in dirs+files:
   f=Path(parent)/basename;s=f.lstat()
   assert s.st_uid==os.getuid() and not stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode) and (stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode))
   if not stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode):continue
   assert s.st_nlink==1
   own.append({'path':str(f),'bytes':s.st_size,'allocated_bytes':s.st_blocks*512,'uid':s.st_uid,'inode':s.st_ino,'mtime_ns':s.st_mtime_ns,'device':s.st_dev,'nlink':s.st_nlink,'category':'human_authorized_unreferenced_hf_model'})
 rows.extend(own);groups.append({'path':str(p),'files':len(own),'allocated_bytes':sum(r['allocated_bytes'] for r in own),'reference_evidence':g['reference_evidence']})
assert len(groups)==7
out=Path('logs/review')/name;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
mp=out/'manifest.json';mp.write_text(json.dumps({'authorization':'a0076849','files':rows,'groups':groups,'retained':kept,'source_inventory':{'file':str(src),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}},indent=2))
sha=hashlib.sha256(mp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
lines=['\n\n## 2026-11-09 21:39 ET — hf_ckpts 删前模型清单\n','完整2245个 configs/results（含archive/gzip）引用扫描通过；以下7个模型均无引用、归本账号，无symlink。Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct基座在另一个受保护缓存路径中，本次不碰；_download_test/_lock_test未判定为模型，保留。全部逐文件stat清单：'+str(mp)+'；SHA256 '+sha+'。只删除这些模型目录内清单上的文件。\n','|模型路径|文件数|allocated GB（十进制）|','|---|---:|---:|']
for g in groups:lines.append('|'+g['path']+'|'+str(g['files'])+'|'+format(g['allocated_bytes']/1e9,'.6f')+'|')
with Path('STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
metrics={'model_count':len(groups),'file_count':len(rows),'allocated_bytes':sum(g['allocated_bytes'] for g in groups),'manifest':{'file':str(mp),'sha256':sha},'deletion_performed':False,'qwen3b_base_preserved':True}
Path('results',name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metrics':metrics,'config':{'authorization':'a0076849','scope':'exact pre-deletion model inventory; root deletion still separate'}},indent=2));print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics),flush=True)
